decisions.reason: As a bread close to the core range that remained visible after launch, it likely meets a satisfactory aspiration level and does not create enough pressure for problemistic search.
This sweet pastry fits the firm's established craft offer and, absent signs of poor performance, a bakery with some slack would usually continue it rather than redeploy resources.

Although newer and therefore a bit more uncertain, a farmhouse bread is tightly aligned with the firm's traditional strengths, so management would likely give it more time unless clear shortfalls emerged.
The poppy seed Christmas stollen was highlighted as a flagship and had a gold award, indicating performance above aspiration and making withdrawal very unlikely.

The premium Christmas stollen also received a gold award, but because it overlaps with the more prominently positioned flagship stollen its retention is slightly less certain even though it still likely stays.
